item.title: Singer-songwriter Andrew Greer holds book signing
item.description: Andrew Greer, the editor/author of “More than a President: Sundays with Jimmy Carter” recently held a book signing at Topiaries. item.title: The Americus-Sumter County Movement Remembered Committee receives gifted artwork
item.description: The Americus-Sumter County Movement Remembered Committee, Inc. received a significant gift from longtime supporter and art collector, Joan Groover of Atlanta. It is a stirring oil painting by West Point Georgia native Lorenzo Scott, shown in photo with painting. item.title: Americus City Council hears citizen concerns
item.description: The Americus City Council heard from concerned citizens during the November 20 meeting. Clifford Morgan addressed the Council, asking the reason why City Manager Diadra Powell was suspended and later terminated. He also asked what the result of the investigation into the City Manager’s department was. Morgan asked for honesty and transparency from the Council. […]
